purpose: Scale-up design RSI for the commercial DMTO reactor of Lu et al. 2017 (CES 171:244): at the paper's methanol throughput (241 t/h) and fresh-catalyst rate, choose main-zone diameter and height, bed temperature, catalyst inventory and steam ratio to maximise the light-olefin yield Y = S(C2H4+C3H6) x eta_MeOH. Screening uses the 2D wedge model (outlet KPIs of the 2D commercial case matched the paper CFD within 0.1 %); the final candidate is checked in 3D by hand. Model-based design study, not a plant recommendation: the kinetics over-predict C2H4/C3H6 at this scale (paper CFD 1.57 vs plant 1.01).
bounds_note: T limited to the arr2 interpolation range of the paper's kinetics table (723-748 K); no extrapolation

constraints.Ug_note: the commercial EMMS heterogeneity fit (Table A4) was generated at Ug = 1.35 m/s; keep within +-20 % so the drag closure stays near its design point
constraints.bed_fill_note: packed bed height (alpha_s 0.55) / main-zone height; above this the expanded turbulent bed reaches the cone

control_reference.source: cases/comm2D (paper commercial conditions, 2D, 150 s, window 90-150 s)
